query: db.readings.aggregate([ { $setWindowFields: { sortBy: { "month": 1 }, output: { running_total: { $avg: "$temperature", window: { documents: ["unbounded", "current"] } } } } }, { $project: { _id: 0, station: 1, temperature: "$temperature", running_total: 1 } }])

db.readings.aggregate([ { $setWindowFields: { sortBy: { "month": 1 }, output: { running_total: { $sum: "$temperature", window: { documents: [0, "current"] } } } } }, { $project: { _id: 0, station: 1, temperature: "$temperature", running_total: 1 } }])
